voice_identity: Original warm, deep, charismatic voice; conversational swagger with a soulful melodic lift. Slight rasp welcome, never an imitation of a named performer.
verse_delivery: Close-mic, intimate, warm spoken delivery with relaxed confidence and clear diction.
pre_chorus_delivery: Speech-shaped rhythmic singing; gradually open the vowels and build anticipation.
chorus_delivery: Big expressive soulful house-vocal melody; joyful, memorable, confident, and emotionally open.
bridge_delivery: Return to intimate spoken delivery over a stripped bass pulse; build energy into the final drop.
gang_response: Layered, energetic, human group shouts on EAT ON IT, DRINK ON IT, LIVE ON IT, and THIS IS IT; friends-around-the-table energy rather than stadium crowd.

arrangement_layers.lead: Center, mostly dry, intelligible; selective double on hook phrases.
arrangement_layers.harmonies: Tight three-part harmony on selected chorus tails, not every line.
arrangement_layers.gang_vocals: Wide layered responses with slight human variation; avoid synthetic mass-crowd wash.
arrangement_layers.effects: Short plate or slap delay; restrained reverb; natural breaths preserved.

note: Performance direction approved by user. Exact melody, note pitches, phoneme sequence and syllable timing remain subject to separate human review.
